Topology: Built on a mesa with distinct slopes and stairways connecting upper and lower campus, but compact enough to cross on foot in 20 minutes.
Airport_Distance: 12 miles (~15-20 min drive) to San Diego International Airport (SAN).
Transit_Options: Direct MTS Green Line Trolley station on campus connecting straight to downtown and Mission Valley.
Neighborhood_Vibe: Dense, student-heavy suburban college area immediately surrounding campus; vibrant local spots with fast access to North Park, Hillcrest, and the beaches.
Housing_Status: Guaranteed for incoming freshmen and sophomores; off-campus rental market in the surrounding San Diego neighborhoods is competitive and expensive.
Medical_Access: No primary on-campus teaching hospital, but positioned within 30 minutes of major research and medical powerhouses like UCSD Health and the Torrey Pines Mesa biotech cluster.

Topology: Flat, coastal campus built on a bluff directly adjacent to the Pacific Ocean; exceptionally bike-friendly with extensive dedicated paths and flat terrain.
Airport_Distance: 10 miles (~15 min drive) to Santa Barbara Municipal Airport (SBA).
Transit_Options: MTD local bus network serves campus heavily, though bikes and walking are the primary modes of transport for students.
Neighborhood_Vibe: Laid-back, vibrant beach town culture anchored by Isla Vista—a legendary, dense student community directly adjacent to campus packed with surf shops, local eats, and weekend energy.
Housing_Status: Guaranteed for incoming freshmen, but the off-campus rental market in Isla Barbara/Goleta is notoriously competitive and expensive.
Medical_Access: No on-campus teaching hospital, but connected via regional transit and close proximity to Cottage Health medical networks and local biotech research centers.

Topology: Picturesque rolling campus tucked right against the foothills of the Rocky Mountains with gentle slopes, beautiful stone pathways, and iconic outdoor gathering quads.
Airport_Distance: 28 miles (~40 min drive) to Denver International Airport (DEN) via regional highway and direct airport bus lines.
Transit_Options: RTD regional bus system and the on-campus HOP transit route connect students seamlessly across Boulder and to local trailheads.
Neighborhood_Vibe: Vibrant college-town atmosphere anchored by the historic Pearl Street Mall and The Hill directly adjacent to campus, offering a lively mix of local coffee shops, eateries, and student culture.
Housing_Status: Guaranteed for incoming freshmen in the residential academic programs; off-campus housing in Boulder is competitive, heavily regulated, and expensive.
Medical_Access: Campus medical services available via Wardenburg Health Center; proximal to Boulder Community Health facilities.
